scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.dev:overlay: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=overlay
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=overlay
